title: Transfer Learning for High-dimensional Quantile Regression with Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2411.19933v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Information from related source studies can often enhance the findings of a target study. However, the distribution shift between target and source studies can severely impact the efficiency of knowledge transfer. In the high-dimensional regression setting, existing transfer approaches mainly focus on the parameter shift. In this paper, we focus on the high-dimensional quantile regression with knowledge transfer under three types of distribution shift: parameter shift, covariate shift, and residual shift. We propose a novel transferable set and a new transfer framework to address the above three discrepancies. Non-asymptotic estimation error bounds and source detection consistency are established to validate the availability and superiority of our method in the presence of distribution shift. translated_title: 分布偏移下高维分位数回归的迁移学习
translated_abstract: 来自相关源研究的信息通常能够增强目标研究的发现。然而，目标研究与源研究之间的分布偏移会严重影响知识迁移的效率。在高维回归的设定下，现有的迁移方法主要关注参数偏移。本文关注知识迁移下的高维分位数回归在三种类型分布偏移中的表现：参数偏移、协变量偏移和残差偏移。我们提出了一种新颖的可迁移集合和一种新的迁移框架来应对上述三种差异。我们建立了非渐近估计误差界和源检测一致性，以验证我们的方法在存在分布偏移时的可用性与优越性。此外，我们还提出了一种正交去偏方法用于带知识迁移的统计推断，从而获得更精细的渐近性质。
tldr: 该论文针对高维分位数回归，提出了一种新的可迁移集合与迁移学习框架，能够同时应对参数偏移、协变量偏移和残差偏移三种分布偏移问题，并通过非渐近误差界、源检测一致性理论以及正交去偏推断方法证明了其有效性和优越性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel transferable set and transfer learning framework for high-dimensional quantile regression that addresses three types of distribution shift—parameter shift, covariate shift, and residual shift—with theoretical guarantees including non-asymptotic error bounds, source detection consistency, and an orthogonal debiased inference approach.
